column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3623): one subtest per registered backend, so mysql and mssql skip in this PostgreSQL-only job while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by NAME in this job's own CI report (skipped: /mysql, /mssql), not derived from a delta and not counted with all three DSNs set, where it would read zero. The test reads each seeded key's id back from the table and checks the lookup returns the matched row's, on both auth.TenantStore and the engine store.
